notes.author: Mira Castellanos
notes.text: Kickoff. Recovering a stalled tech transfer of the company's only product to a contract manufacturer. $700k.

notes.author: Isha Kapoor
notes.text: Root cause is not process: Dr. Farhan Siddiqui and Greta Lindholm refuse to share batch data with each other's teams after a dispute over the founding patent.

notes.author: Mira Castellanos
notes.text: Board intervened; Greta departed. Transfer resumed under an interim lead. Our work was mostly mediation.

notes.author: Isha Kapoor
notes.text: Engagement wrapping. Outcome driven entirely by one interpersonal conflict and a board decision specific to this company.

simulation.note: No generalizable lesson survives anonymization: the only lesson is a specific interpersonal conflict.
simulation.why: Outcome driven by a single interpersonal dispute; any lesson specific enough to be useful would identify the parties.
